svg.title: A year at the workbench — public GitHub activity
svg.desc: 829 contributions across 133 active days, from 26 Oct 2025 through 30 Oct 2026. Longest streak 11 days. Busiest day 22 Feb 2026 with 40. Weekly totals are drawn above the calendar. Snapshot 2026-10-30.
svg.text: Public GitHub contributions, one square per day.
